title: business opportunities hanoi - u.s. embassy & consulate in vietnam
paragraphs: general services office, u.s. embassy hanoi, vietnam seeks to enter into contracts with qualified, reliable firms with sufficient facilities, financing and work experiences for the supplies and services listed below. please click on the bids below for more information or if there are no bids, check back at another time. thank you for your interest in working with the u.s. embassy in hanoi.

general services office, u.s. embassy hanoi, vietnam seeks to enter into contracts with qualified, reliable firms with sufficient facilities, financing and work experiences for the supplies and services listed below. please click on the bids below for more information or if there are no bids, check back at another time. thank you for your interest in working with the u.s. embassy in hanoi.

the u. s. embassy in hanoi will conduct an auction sale of used office and household furniture, appliances and other miscellaneous items from april 25 to may 6, 2024 . the auction will take place completely online at https://online-auction.state.gov . all interested parties and individuals are invited to take part and submit their bid.  please connect to the following link for further details about registration and auction rules
